summary: CR-136 Item Sales Ledger frontend testing completed. Found and fixed a critical data rendering bug in topFoodSalesService.js. After fix, all core features verified working: page loads, sidebar, KPI strip, tabs, accordion expansion, column chooser, download dropdown. The API returned real data for Shimla food court with 4 stations.

integration_issues.issue: FIXED: topFoodSalesService.js used raw.data (undefined) instead of raw directly since fetchOrReuse returns the bare data array. All items showed 0 despite API returning data.

critical_code_review_comments: topFoodSalesService.js: fetchOrReuse only caches/returns `data` field, but service code expected `{data, grandTotal, apiFrom, apiTo}` object. Fixed to use rawData (bare array) directly.

External API (preprod.mygenie.online/top-food sales-report) response takes 8-12 seconds. During this time isLoading=true causes pointer-events-none and disabled Download button. This is expected behavior but may feel slow to users.
The date inputs in header show today's dates even after clicking 1Y preset in some renders — minor cosmetic issue that doesn't affect data correctness. The data correctly fetches for 1Y range.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CR-136 Item Sales Ledger at /reports-module/item-sales. Critical bug fixed in topFoodSalesService.js (raw.data vs raw). Page loads correctly with all features working. External API takes ~10-12s to respond. When testing accordion/download, always wait 12+ seconds after clicking a preset before interacting. All 4 stations (GUPTAJEE, ZORKO, MSB, CREAMBELLPARLOUR) appear in By Station tab. Complementary tab shows empty state (no complementary items in test data).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: insightsCache.js fetchOrReuse() caches only the `data` field from fetchFn's return object and returns just `data` (the array). topFoodSalesService.js (CR-136 new code) incorrectly expected fetchOrReuse to return the full { data, grandTotal, apiFrom, apiTo } object, so it accessed raw.data (undefined → []) and raw.grandTotal (undefined → 0). Fix: use the rawData return value directly as the food_sales_report array. grandTotal derived from summing row.netSales.
